title: Log Aggregation with ELK, Fluentd, and Loki
title_es: Agregación de Logs con ELK, Fluentd y Loki
description: Runnable log aggregation stack: Docker Compose with Fluentd, Elasticsearch and Kibana, Fluentd config with file buffering and retries, and a Winston logger with correlation IDs.
description_es: Stack ejecutable de agregación de logs: Docker Compose con Fluentd, Elasticsearch y Kibana, configuración de Fluentd con buffering en disco y reintentos, y logger de Winston con correlation IDs.
